scope.note: Any laboratory grown stone offered for sale, at any size.

checks.label: Growth method stated
checks.plain: The paperwork says plainly that the stone was grown, and how.

checks.label: Producing facility named
checks.plain: We know which reactor grew it.

checks.label: No wording implying it was mined
checks.plain: Nothing on the invoice suggests the stone came out of the ground.

checks.label: Batch traces to the stone
checks.plain: The reactor batch and the grading report agree on weight.

evidence_required: Statement that the diamond is laboratory grown
Growth method: CVD or HPHT, and the reactor type
Batch identifier and growth run dates

undisclosed_synthetic.measure: FTC deceptive practices exposure, plus customer restitution and returns
undisclosed_synthetic.note: Civil penalty exposure is per violation and is set by the Commission.
